list_notifications.title: List Notifications
list_notifications.description: List task notifications of one type (assignee changes, status changes, priority, due date, reminders, details edits) for the user, optionally for any user or one list. Returns an array of notification records with task and user info.

any_user.description: Include notifications for any user, not just you.

list_id.description: Restrict to this list id (from list_lists).

list_email_tasks.title: List Email Tasks
list_email_tasks.description: List tasks that have Gmail emails/threads attached, filtered by list, assignee, status or a text query. Returns task records with thread id/subject. Use list_tasks for all tasks.

list_id.description: Restrict to this list id (from list_lists).

list_list_users.title: List List Users
list_list_users.description: List users who are members of a given Yanado list. Returns id, name and email for each; use the ids as assigneeId on tasks.

list_users.title: List Team Users
list_users.description: List users on your Yanado team, optionally restricted to members of one list. Returns id, name and email for each.

list_id.description: Restrict to this list id (from list_lists).

list_list_statuses.title: List List Statuses
list_list_statuses.description: List the statuses (workflow columns) defined on a list. Returns id and name; the id is required as statusId when creating tasks.

list_lists.title: List Lists
list_lists.description: List all Yanado lists (projects) available to you. Returns id and name for each; use the ids to scope tasks, users and statuses.

list_tasks.title: List Tasks
list_tasks.description: List tasks, optionally filtered by list, assignee, status or a free-text query. Returns task records (id, name, description, due date, priority, list, status, assignee). Use get_task for one task.

list_id.description: Restrict to this list id (from list_lists).

create_task.title: Create Task
create_task.description: Create a task in a Yanado list with a name and status, optionally assigning it, setting description/due date/form fields, or attaching an email thread. Returns the created task including taskId.

status_id.description: Status id for the task (from list_list_statuses).

assignee_id.description: User id to assign the task to.

form.description: Custom form field values for the task, as an object of properties.

thread_email.description: Participant email of an attached email thread.

get_task.title: Get Task
get_task.description: Fetch one task by id with name, description, due date, priority, list, status and assignee.

update_task.title: Update Task
update_task.description: Update a task's name, description, status, list, assignee, due date, form fields, or archive it. Only provided fields change. Returns the updated task.

list_id.description: Move the task to this list.

list_comments.title: List Comments
list_comments.description: List task comments, optionally within one list or matching a text query. Returns comment records with message, author and the parent task's details.

list_id.description: Restrict to this list id (from list_lists).
